name: Zomato
one_liner: Zomato connects consumers with local restaurants and delivery partners for food ordering, while offering ingredient supply chain services to restaurant businesses.
what_you_sell: Food ordering and delivery platform services, B2B restaurant supply chain solutions (Hyperpure), quick-commerce grocery delivery (Blinkit), and entertainment/dining experience bookings (District).
who_buys_it: Consumers ordering food or groceries online, and restaurant owners seeking online order delivery networks and raw material sourcing.
_claims_to_check: Claims to service 300,000+ restaurants across 800+ cities
Claims to have 27 million+ monthly active app customers
Claims 600,000+ delivery partners earn their livelihood through the platform
Claims over 3 billion+ total orders delivered
Claims 20,000+ partner restaurants offer up to 30% extra off under the Gold program
